name: vscode-swoftlang
description: Language support and a live execution tracer for the SwoftLang (.sw) scripting language.

swoftlang.swoftcPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `swoftc` compiler binary. If empty, resolution falls back to the `SWOFTC` environment variable, then `swoftc` on `PATH`, then `<workspaceFolder>/compiler/_build/default/bin/main.exe`.

swoftlang.debugPort.description: TCP port of the SwoftLang debug WebSocket server (server must be started with --debug).

swoftlang.scriptsDir.markdownDescription: Directory the debug server's `scripts/…` paths are relative to. If empty, the server's `hello.scriptsDir` is used, falling back to `<workspaceFolder>/scripts`.

swoftlang.debug.autoConnect.description: Connect to the debug server automatically when a SwoftLang file is opened.

swoftlang.debug.autoReveal.description: When a trace arrives for a file that is not open, open it (without stealing focus) so the pulse is visible.

swoftlang.debug.followExecution.description: Scroll the editor to follow each executing line. Off by default so the tracer never hijacks your scroll while a loop keeps firing.
